story.title: OpenAI and Microsoft end exclusivity: OpenAI free to sell on AWS in exchange for revenue-share deal
story.summary: OpenAI has secured major concessions from its largest investor Microsoft, dissolving the exclusive cloud-hosting arrangement and allowing OpenAI to sell its products on Amazon Web Services. In return, Microsoft receives an expanded revenue-share agreement, and OpenAI models including a new agent service became available on AWS Bedrock within 24 hours of the deal being announced. The move marks a fundamental shift in the cloud AI landscape, opening OpenAI's technology to a far broader base of enterprise customers.
